name: opik
displayName: Opik - Save and share your chat history
description: Export your chat history from Cursor to Opik.

opik.apiKey.markdownDescription:
Opik API Key for authentication. Get your key at [Comet Settings](https://www.comet.com/api/my/settings/). 

Alternatively, you can set this in `~/.opik.config` file.

opik.apiUrl.markdownDescription: API URL for Opik backend. Change this only if you're using a self-hosted instance.

opik.workspace.markdownDescription: Workspace name where your traces will be stored.

opik.projectName.markdownDescription: Project name for organizing Cursor chat sessions within your workspace.

opik.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable automatic registration of the Opik MCP server with Cursor to provide enhanced context in your chats.

opik.usageEnrichment.enabled.markdownDescription: Fetch token counts and cost from Cursor and attach them to the logged spans. Uses your existing Cursor sign-in; no extra credentials are needed. Turn this off to log conversations without usage.

opik.detailedSpans.enabled.markdownDescription: Log every step of a Cursor turn as a nested span: one `llm` span per model call, one `tool` span per tool call, and a `general` span for each Cursor error. Turn this off to log only the question and the answer.

opik.detailedSpans.maxPayloadChars.markdownDescription: Maximum size of the input and the output of a single span, in characters. Larger payloads keep their start and their end, and the middle is replaced by a marker.

opik.detailedSpans.maxSpansPerTurn.markdownDescription: Maximum number of child spans for a single turn. Above this number the first and the last spans are kept, and a `truncated-steps` span records how many were dropped.

opik.enableDebugLogs.markdownDescription: Enable detailed debug logging for troubleshooting. Logs will appear in the Output panel under 'Opik Debug'.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test-spans
